class OptionalFields {
  #amount?: number;
  #required: number;
  constructor(required: number, amount?: number) {
    this.#required = required;
    this.#amount = amount;
  }
  print() {
    if (this.#amount !== undefined) console.log(this.#required.toFixed(1), this.#amount.toFixed(1));
  }
}
new OptionalFields(1).print();
new OptionalFields(2, 3).print();

class Accessors {
  get #text(): string { return "hello"; }
  set #text(value: string | number) {}
  static get #count(): number { return 7; }
  static set #count(value: string | number) {}
  print() {
    this.#text = 1;
    console.log(this.#text.toUpperCase());
  }
  static print() {
    this.#count = "seven";
    console.log(this.#count.toFixed(1));
  }
}
new Accessors().print();
Accessors.print();

const independent = { add(this: void, number: number) { return number + 1; } };
class Receiver {
  add(this: void, number: number) { return number + 1; }
}
console.log(independent.add(2), new Receiver().add(2), independent.add.call(undefined, 2));
